```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(gtsummary))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(gt))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggdist))
#suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggsankey))

source("R/config.R")

data_path = "~/git/Pattern/data/MedrioExport202312211002/"
figure_path = "../../../figures/multicenter_study/"

enrollment_data <- readxl::read_xlsx(paste0(data_path, "LRT Enrollment_Collection_Site.xlsx"), na = c("NA", "<NA>", "N/A", "n/a"))
collection_data <- readxl::read_xlsx(paste0(data_path, "LRT_Enrollment_.xlsx"), na = c("NA", "<NA>", "N/A", "n/a"))
culture_data <- 
  readxl::read_xlsx(paste0(data_path, "Reference_LRT_Culture_Results.xlsx"), na = c("NA", "<NA>", "N/A", "n/a")) |> 
    mutate(LRT_REF_RPT_BIN = factor(LRT_REF_RPT_BIN, levels = c("<1,000", "1,000-10,000", "10,000-100,000", ">100,000"), ordered = T))
repeat_culture_data <- readxl::read_xlsx(paste0(data_path, "Reference_LRT_Culture_Results_Repeat.xlsx") , na = c("NA", "<NA>", "N/A", "n/a"))
gram_stain_data <- 
  readxl::read_xlsx(paste0(data_path, "Reference_LRT_Gram Stain.xlsx"), na = c("NA", "<NA>", "N/A", "n/a")) |> 
    mutate(
      across(matches("PLS_AMT|ORG_AMT"), ~factor(., levels = c("None", "Rare", "Few", "Moderate", "Abundant"), ordered = T)),
      across(matches("EPI|CELL|RBC"), ~factor(., levels = c("None", "Few", "Abundant"), ordered = T)),
      LRT_REF_GS_MORPH = str_replace_all(pattern = " in clusters| in clusters | in pairs and chains | in pairs and chains| in pairs| in pairs | and pseudohyphae", replacement = "", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH),
      LRT_REF_GS_MORPH = fct_infreq(factor(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH)))
repeat_gram_stain_data <- readxl::read_xlsx(paste0(data_path, "Reference_LRT_Gram Stain_Repeat.xlsx"), na = c("NA", "<NA>", "N/A", "n/a"))

group_gram_morph_map <- read_delim(paste0(data_path, "../group_gram_morph_map.txt")) |> mutate(across(everything(), ~str_trim(.))) |> distinct() |> 
  mutate(Morphology = str_to_sentence(Morphology),
         gram = case_when(
           grepl("negative", `Gram stain`) ~ "Negative",
           grepl("positive", `Gram stain`) ~ "Positive",
           grepl("Acid", `Gram stain`, ignore.case = T) ~ "Acid-Fast",
           T ~ "Other")) |>
  distinct()

genus_group_map <- read_delim(paste0(data_path, "../genus_species_attribute_map.tsv")) |> mutate(across(everything(), ~str_trim(.))) |> distinct()

organism_gram_group_map <- left_join(genus_group_map, group_gram_morph_map)
```

This is a general notebook of code and results for the respiratory pre-clinical, multi-center study that aims to address the research questions highlighted by Drs. Burnham and Yarbrough.

# Topic 1: Respiratory Cultures and Gram Stains

## Demographics

A break-down of the demographical data for contained within the "LRT Enrollment\_.xlsx" and "Enrollment_Collection_Site" files.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Patient Sites and Locations

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| collapse: true

demographics_input <- 
  bind_rows(
    enrollment_data,
    collection_data
  ) |> 
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      TypeID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[1],
      SiteID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[2],
      SpecimenID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[3],
      ReplicateID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[4],
    ) |> ungroup() |> 
    group_by(SubjectID) |> 
    fill(everything(), .direction = "downup") |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    distinct()

location_data <- 
  demographics_input |> 
    select(SubjectID, SiteID, SpecimenID, LRT_PtLocation) |> 
    drop_na(LRT_PtLocation) |> 
    mutate(LRT_PtLocation = ifelse(LRT_PtLocation == "General Medicine Floor", "Medicine", LRT_PtLocation))

location_counts <- 
  location_data |> 
    group_by(SiteID) |> 
    mutate(LRT_PtLocation = fct_rev(fct_infreq(factor(LRT_PtLocation))))

gg_site_counts <- 
  ggplot(location_counts, aes(y = SiteID)) + 
    geom_bar()
ggsave(paste0(figure_path, "patient_site_counts.pdf"), gg_site_counts, width = 8, height = 8)

gg_location_counts <- 
  ggplot(location_counts, aes(y = LRT_PtLocation)) + 
    geom_bar()
ggsave(paste0(figure_path, "patient_location_counts.pdf"), gg_location_counts, width = 8, height = 8)

gg_location_counts_by_site <- 
  ggplot(location_counts, aes(y = LRT_PtLocation)) + 
    geom_bar() + 
    facet_wrap(~SiteID)
ggsave(paste0(figure_path, "patient_location_counts_by_site.pdf"), gg_location_counts_by_site, width = 8, height = 8)

combined <- ggpubr::ggarrange(ggpubr::ggarrange(gg_site_counts, gg_location_counts, nrow = 2), gg_location_counts_by_site, nrow = 1, widths = c(0.4, 0.6))
ggsave(paste0(figure_path, "patient_location_counts_combined.pdf"), width = 8, height = 5)

combined
```

## Turn-Around Time

A summary of time intervals between collection ("LRT_SpecimenCollection") and when it was originally cultured ("LRT_DT_Cx").

### Table

```{r}

timing_data <-
  demographics_input |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(hours_from_collect_to_culture = as.numeric(LRT_DT_Cx - LRT_SpecimenCollection) / (60 * 60),
           hours_from_collect_to_enrollment = as.numeric(LRT_SpecEnroll - LRT_SpecimenCollection) / (60 * 60)) |>
    filter(hours_from_collect_to_culture > 0)

gt_tat <-
  tbl_summary(timing_data, include = c(hours_from_collect_to_culture, hours_from_collect_to_enrollment), by = SiteID, label = list("hours_from_collect_to_culture" ~ "Collect-to-Culture (hours)")) |>
    italicize_levels() |>
    bold_labels() |>
    add_p(test = everything() ~ "fisher.test", test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(simulate.p.value = TRUE)) |>
    bold_p() |>
    add_overall() |>
    #add_ci(method = list(all_continuous() ~ "wilcox.test"), pattern = "{stat} ({ci})") |>
    #modify_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**<br>*N = {n}*") |>
    as_gt() |>
    theme_pattern() |>
    tab_header(title = "Turn-Around Times",
                 subtitle = "By Site")
gt::gtsave(gt_tat, filename = paste0(figure_path, "time_from_collect_to_culture_table.html"))
gt::gtsave(gt_tat, filename = paste0(figure_path, "time_from_collect_to_culture_table.docx"))

gt_tat
```

#### ECDFs

```{r}

medians <- timing_data |> group_by(SiteID) |> summarise(median = median(hours_from_collect_to_culture))

library(geomtextpath)

gg_timing_ecdfs_by_site <-
  ggplot(timing_data, aes(x = hours_from_collect_to_culture, color = SiteID)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.50, alpha = 0.25, linetype = "dashed") +
    stat_ecdf(linewidth = 1.2, na.rm = T) +
    geom_textsegment(data = medians, aes(x = median, xend = median, y = 0, yend = 0.50, color = SiteID, label = SiteID), linetype = "dashed", fontface = "bold", hjust = 0.75) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Hours", limits = c(0, 12), breaks = seq(0, 12, by = 3), expand = c(0, 0.5)) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Cumulative Proportion", expand = expansion(0.01, 0), breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("", "0.5", "1")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = pattern_colors) +
    annotate("text", x = 10, y = 0.54, label = "Median", fontface = "italic", alpha = 0.25) +
    ggtitle("Hours from Collection to Culture", subtitle = "ECDFs By Site") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(paste0(figure_path, "ecdfs_time_from_collect_to_culture_by_site.pdf"), gg_timing_ecdfs_by_site, width = 8, height = 4)
```

#### Gram Stain Results by Organism

##### Table

```{r}

gram_stain_results_input <- 
  gram_stain_data |> 
    select(SubjectID, matches("LRT"), VarGroup1Row) |> 
    group_by(SubjectID) |> 
    fill(everything(), .direction = "downup") |> 
      rowwise() |>
      mutate(
        TypeID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[1],
        SiteID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[2],
        SpecimenID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[3],
        ReplicateID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[4],
      ) |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    distinct() |> 
    mutate(
      predominant_organism = ifelse(LRT_REF_GS_PO == "Yes", as.character(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH), NA),
      Kingdom = 
        case_when(
          grepl("Gram", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Bacteria", 
          grepl("yeast|fung", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Fungus",
          grepl("mixed", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Mixed",
          T ~ "No Organism"),
      Gram = 
        case_when(
          grepl("pos", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Positive", 
          grepl("neg", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Negative",
          grepl("var", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Variable",
          T ~ NA), 
      Shape = 
        case_when(
          grepl(" cocci", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Cocci",
          grepl(" bacilli", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Bacilli",
          grepl("coccobacil|diplo", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Other"
        ), 
      Grouping = 
        case_when(
          grepl("clusters", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Clusters",
          grepl("chain", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Pairs/Chains",
        )
    ) |> 
    group_by(SubjectID) |>
    mutate(
      organism_detected = any(!is.na(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH), na.rm = T),
      any_GPC = any(grepl("Gram positive cocci|Gram-positive cocci", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH)),
      any_GNB = any(grepl("Gram negative bac|Gram-negative bac", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH)),
      any_yeast = any(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH %in% c("yeast", "Fungal Elements", "Yeast", "Fungal elements")),
      any_mixed = any(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH == "Mixed microorganism", na.rm = T) | any(VarGroup1Row > 1, na.rm = T),
      any_other = ifelse(organism_detected & (!any_GPC & !any_GNB & !any_yeast & !any_mixed), T, F),
      predominant_organism = ifelse(!any_mixed, NA, predominant_organism),
      num_unique_morph = ifelse(organism_detected, length(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH), 0))
```

```{r}
gram_stain_results_BAL_input <- 
  gram_stain_data |> 
    select(SubjectID, matches("LRT"), VarGroup1Row) |> 
    group_by(SubjectID) |> 
    fill(everything(), .direction = "downup") |> 
      rowwise() |>
      mutate(
        TypeID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[1],
        SiteID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[2],
        SpecimenID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[3],
        ReplicateID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[4],
      ) |> ungroup() |> 
    filter(LRT_REF_GS_SPECTYPE == "BAL") |> 
    distinct() |> 
    mutate(
      organism_detected = ifelse(LRT_REF_GS_ORG_AMT == "None", F, T), 
      Kingdom = 
        case_when(
          grepl("Gram", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Bacteria", 
          grepl("yeast|fung", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Fungus",
          grepl("mixed", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Mixed",
          T ~ "No Organism"),
      Gram = 
        case_when(
          grepl("pos", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Positive", 
          grepl("neg", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Negative",
          grepl("var", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Variable",
          T ~ NA), 
      Shape = 
        case_when(
          grepl(" cocci", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Cocci",
          grepl(" bacilli", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Bacilli",
          grepl("coccobacil|diplo", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Other"
        ), 
      Grouping = 
        case_when(
          grepl("clusters", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Clusters",
          grepl("chain", LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, ignore.case = T) ~ "Pairs/Chains",
        )
    )

    italicize_levels() |>
    bold_labels() |>

    tab_header(title = "Gram Stain Results",
```

```{r}
  scale_fill_manual(values = sankey_fill_map, na.value = NA) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sankey_color_map, na.value = NA) +
  theme_alluvial(base_size = 18) +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5)) +
  ggtitle("Gram Stain Results", subtitle = "Endotracheal Aspirates (ETA)")
```

### Abundance Proportions

A breakdown of the reported Gram stain abundances across sites, procedures, and organism types.

```{r}

top_5_morphs <- gram_stain_results_input |> ungroup() |> filter(!is.na(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH)) |> count(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, sort = T) |> drop_na() |> head(5) |> pull(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH)

gg_abundance_by_organism_input <- 
  gram_stain_results_input |> 
    filter(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH %in% top_5_morphs) |> 
    mutate(Abundance_bins = factor(LRT_REF_GS_ORG_AMT, levels = c("Rare", "Few", "Moderate", "Abundant"), labels = c("Rare/Few", "Rare/Few", "Moderate/Abundant", "Moderate/Abundant")))

gg_abundance_by_organism <- 
  ggplot(data = gg_abundance_by_organism_input, aes(y = fct_rev(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH), fill = fct_rev(Abundance_bins))) + 
    geom_bar(position = "fill", alpha = 0.75) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.75, y = 5, hjust = 1, label = "Rare/Few", fontface = "bold", color = "black", size = 8) + 
    annotate("text", x = 0.48, y = 4, hjust = 0, label = "Mod/Abundant", fontface = "bold", color = "white", size = 8) + 
    stat_count(data = gg_abundance_by_organism_input |> drop_na(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH), aes(label = paste0("n = ", ..count..), y = fct_rev(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH)), x = 0.05, hjust = 0, geom = "text", inherit.aes = F, alpha = 0.75, color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 8) + 
    scico::scale_fill_scico_d(palette = "lipari", begin = 0.05, end = 0.95) + 
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Percent", labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)) + 
    ggtitle("Abundance Proportions By Organism Type", subtitle = "Reference Lab, All Sites, All Procedures") +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank(), axis.title.y.left = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
```

## Culture Result Breakdown

A breakdown of the metadata surrounding each organism grown in culture identified by MALDI.

### Tables

```{r}
#| warning: false

culture_data_input <- 
  culture_data |> 
    select(SubjectID, matches("LRT"), VarGroup1Row) |> 
      select(-matches("HAEM|OPTO|BILE|PIC|_WS")) |>
      group_by(SubjectID) |> 
      fill(everything(), .direction = "downup") |> 
        rowwise() |>
        mutate(
          TypeID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[1],
          SiteID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[2],
          SpecimenID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[3],
          ReplicateID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[4],
        ) |> 
      mutate(
        MALDI_ID = ifelse(grepl("Other", LRT_REF_MALDI_ID, ignore.case = T), str_to_sentence(LRT_REF_ID_OTHER), LRT_REF_MALDI_ID)
      ) |> 
      group_by(SubjectID) |> 
      mutate(NUM_UNIQUE_ORGANISMS = length(do::unique_no.NA(MALDI_ID))) |> 
      ungroup() |>
      group_by(SubjectID, LRT_REF_MALDI_ID) |> 
      mutate(max_abundance = max(LRT_REF_RPT_BIN)) |> 
      left_join(organism_gram_group_map, by = join_by(MALDI_ID == `Reference testing identification `)) |> 
      distinct(SubjectID, MALDI_ID, max_abundance, .keep_all = T) |>
      ungroup() |> 
      mutate(MALDI_ID_GROUPED = factor(ifelse(is.na(`Group or alternative name`), MALDI_ID, `Group or alternative name`)), 
             MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED = fct_infreq(fct_lump_min(MALDI_ID_GROUPED, min = 5)))

### Write Culture Result Input to Files
culture_data_input |> write_csv("../../../data/culture_results_input.csv")
culture_data_input |> write_rds("../../../data/culture_results_input.rds")

gt_culture_results <- 
  culture_data_input |> 
  tbl_summary(include = c(LRT_REF_GRWTH_YN, REF_LRT_CONTAM_YN, LRT_REF_RPT_BIN, MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED), missing = "no", label = c("LRT_REF_GRWTH_YN" ~ "Any Growth", "REF_LRT_CONTAM_YN" ~ "Contaminated", "LRT_REF_RPT_BIN" ~ "Colony Count", "MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED" ~ "Organism Identification")) |>
      italicize_levels() |>
      bold_labels() |> 
      modify_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**<br>*N = {n}*") |>
      as_gt() |> 
      theme_pattern() |>
      tab_header(title = "Culture Results",
                   subtitle = "All Sites and Sources")
gt::gtsave(gt_culture_results, filename = paste0(figure_path, "culture_results_table.html"))
gt::gtsave(gt_culture_results, filename = paste0(figure_path, "culture_results_table.docx"))

gt_culture_results_by_site <- 
  culture_data_input |> 
    tbl_summary(include = c(LRT_REF_GRWTH_YN, REF_LRT_CONTAM_YN, LRT_REF_RPT_BIN, MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED, NUM_UNIQUE_ORGANISMS), missing = "no", label = c("LRT_REF_GRWTH_YN" ~ "Any Growth", "REF_LRT_CONTAM_YN" ~ "Contaminated", "LRT_REF_RPT_BIN" ~ "Colony Count", "MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED" ~ "Organism Identification", "NUM_UNIQUE_ORGANISMS" ~ "Unique Organisms Identified"), by = SiteID) |>
```

## Correlating Gram Stain and Culture Results

### Gram Stain to Culture

#### Table

```{r}

culture_gram_join <- 
  full_join(
    gram_stain_results_input |> select(SubjectID, SiteID, LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, LRT_REF_GS_SPECTYPE, predominant_organism, organism_detected, num_unique_morph, matches("AMT|any"), Gram, Shape),
    culture_data_input |> select(SubjectID, LRT_REF_RPT_BIN, MALDI_ID, MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED, MALDI_ID_GROUPED, NUM_UNIQUE_ORGANISMS, max_abundance, culture_tag = `Gram stain`, culture_morph = Morphology, culture_gram = gram)) |>
  left_join(demographics_input |> select(SubjectID, LRT_PtAge, LRT_PtSex, LRT_PtLocation)) |> 
        mutate(significant_growth_all = 
             case_when(
               LRT_REF_GS_SPECTYPE == "BAL" & max_abundance %in% c("10,000-100,000", ">100,000") ~ "Significant",
               LRT_REF_GS_SPECTYPE == "BAL" & max_abundance %in% c("<1,000", "1,000-10,000") ~ "Insignificant",
               LRT_REF_GS_SPECTYPE == "BAL" & max_abundance %in% c(NA) ~ "None",
               LRT_REF_GS_SPECTYPE == "ETA" & max_abundance %in% c(">100,000") ~ "Significant",
               LRT_REF_GS_SPECTYPE == "ETA" & max_abundance %in% c("<1,000", "1,000-10,000", "10,000-100,000") ~ "Insignificant",
               LRT_REF_GS_SPECTYPE == "ETA" & max_abundance %in% c(NA) ~ "None"
             ), 
           significant_growth_all = factor(significant_growth_all, levels = c("None", "Insignificant", "Significant")),
           significant_growth_bin = factor(significant_growth_all, levels = c("None", "Insignificant", "Significant"), labels = c("None/Insignificant", "None/Insignificant", "Significant"))) |>
      distinct() |> 
      group_by(SubjectID) |> 
      mutate(gram_equals_culture = (LRT_REF_GS_MORPH == culture_tag) | (LRT_REF_GS_MORPH == "Mixed microorganism" & NUM_UNIQUE_ORGANISMS > 1),
             any_concordant_growth = any(gram_equals_culture, na.rm = T),
             any_significant_growth = any(significant_growth_all == "Significant", na.rm = T),
             `Epithelial Cells` = max(LRT_REF_SQ_EPI_AMT, na.rm = T),
             `Polymorphonucleocytes` = max(LRT_REF_PLS_AMT, na.rm = T),
             `Red Blood Cells` = max(LRT_REF_RBC_AMT, na.rm = T),
             `Organism Abundance` = max(LRT_REF_GS_ORG_AMT, na.rm = T),
             `No Organism Seen` = !any(organism_detected, na.rm = T),
             `Gram-Positive Cocci` = any_GPC,
             `Gram-Negative Bacilli` = any_GNB,
             `Yeast/Fungus` = any_yeast,
             `Mixed Microorganisms` = any_mixed,
             `Other Morphology` = any_other) |>
    ungroup() 

## Write Joined Data to Files
culture_gram_join |> write_csv("../../../data/culture_gram_results_joined.csv")
culture_gram_join |> write_rds("../../../data/culture_gram_results_joined.rds")

## Make Subject-Wise Data
culture_gram_join_by_subject <- 
  culture_gram_join |> 
  group_by(SubjectID) |>
  fill(predominant_organism, .direction = "downup") |> 
  mutate(`Predominant Morphology` = 
           case_when(
             num_unique_morph == 0 ~ NA, 
             num_unique_morph == 1 ~ LRT_REF_GS_MORPH, 
             num_unique_morph > 1 & !is.na(predominant_organism) ~ predominant_organism,
             num_unique_morph > 1 & is.na(predominant_organism) ~ "Mixed microorganism"), 
         `Predominant Morphology (w/ Other)` = fct_other(`Predominant Morphology`, keep = c("Gram-negative bacilli", "Mixed microorganism", "Gram-positive cocci", "Yeast", NA))) |> 
  select(SubjectID, Site = SiteID, Age = LRT_PtAge, Sex = LRT_PtSex, Location = LRT_PtLocation, Procedure = LRT_REF_GS_SPECTYPE,
         `Epithelial Cells`, `Polymorphonucleocytes`, `Red Blood Cells`, `Organism Abundance`, `No Organism Seen`, `Predominant Morphology`, `Predominant Morphology (w/ Other)`, 
         `Gram-Positive Cocci`, `Gram-Negative Bacilli`, `Mixed Microorganisms`, `Yeast/Fungus`, `Other Morphology`, `Unique Morphologies Seen` = num_unique_morph, 
         `Any Concordant Growth` = any_concordant_growth, `Any Significant Growth` = any_significant_growth, `Unique Organisms Grown` = NUM_UNIQUE_ORGANISMS) |> 
  distinct()

culture_gram_join_by_subject |> write_csv("../../../data/culture_gram_join_by_subject.csv")
culture_gram_join_by_subject |> write_rds("../../../data/culture_gram_join_by_subject.rds")
  


any_significant_growth_model_input <- 
  culture_gram_join |> 
    select(SubjectID, any_significant_growth, `Epithelial Cells`, `Polymorphonucleocytes`, `Red Blood Cells`, `Organism Abundance`, `No Organism Seen`, `Gram-Positive Cocci`, `Gram-Negative Bacilli`, `Mixed Microorganisms`, `Other Morphology`) |>
    distinct() |> 
    select(-SubjectID)

morph_counts <- any_significant_growth_model_input |> select(`No Organism Seen`, `Gram-Positive Cocci`, `Gram-Negative Bacilli`, `Mixed Microorganisms`, `Other Morphology`) |> rowSums()

any_significant_growth_model_input <- 
  any_significant_growth_model_input |> 
    mutate(`Mixed Microorganisms` = ifelse(morph_counts > 1, T, `Mixed Microorganisms`),
           across(c(`No Organism Seen`, `Gram-Positive Cocci`, `Gram-Negative Bacilli`, `Other Morphology`), ~ifelse(`Mixed Microorganisms`, F, .x))) |> 
    filter(`Epithelial Cells` != "Abundant")
```

### Culture to Gram Stain

#### Table

```{r}

culture_matches_gram <- 
  culture_gram_join |> 
    group_by(SubjectID, MALDI_ID) |> 
    mutate(any_gram = any(!is.na(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH)), any_culture = any(!is.na(culture_tag)), any_gram_equals_culture = any(gram_equals_culture, na.rm = T)) |> 
    arrange(SubjectID, MALDI_ID, desc(LRT_REF_RPT_BIN)) |>
    ungroup() |> 
    slice_head(n = 1, by = c(SubjectID, MALDI_ID)) |>
    drop_na(MALDI_ID) |> 
    filter(culture_morph != "Yeast") |> 
    mutate(culture_morph = fct_lump_n(factor(MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED), n = 7), 
           culture_abundance = factor(max_abundance, ordered = F), 
           culture_equals_gram = factor(gram_equals_culture, labels = c("Not Seen", "Seen on Gram Stain")))

      bold_labels() |>

        as_gt() |> 
        theme_pattern() |>
        tab_header(title = "Frequency of Cultured Organisms with Concordant Gram Stains",
                     subtitle = "All Sources, All Sites")
```

#### Multivariate Modelling

```{r}

glm_culture_to_gram <- glm(culture_equals_gram ~ MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED + culture_abundance, data = culture_matches_gram |> filter(culture_tag %in% c("Gram-positive cocci", "Gram-negative bacilli", "Mixed microorganism", "Gram-positive bacilli")), family = binomial)

gt_culture_to_gram_model <- 
  tbl_regression(glm_culture_to_gram, exponentiate = T, label = c("MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED" ~ "Culture Morphology", "culture_abundance" ~ "Culture Abundance"), missing = "no") |>
    add_n(location = "level") |> 
    add_nevent(location = "level") |> 
    bold_labels() |> 
    italicize_levels() |> 
    bold_p() |>
    modify_table_body(
      ~ .x %>% 
        dplyr::mutate(
          stat_nevent = 
            ifelse(
              !is.na(stat_nevent),
              paste0(style_sigfig(stat_nevent / stat_n, scale = 100), "%"),
              NA
            ),
          ci = ifelse(
            !is.na(conf.low) & !is.na(conf.high),
            paste0("[", style_sigfig(conf.low, digits = 2), " - ", style_sigfig(conf.high, digits = 2), "]"),
            NA
          ))
    ) %>%
    modify_cols_merge(
      pattern = "{estimate}, {ci}",
      rows = !is.na(conf.low)
    ) |>
    modify_header(stat_nevent = "**%**", estimate = "**OR, [95% CI]**") |> 
      as_gt() |> 
      theme_pattern() |>
      tab_header(title = "Frequency of Organisms with Concordant Gram Stains", subtitle = "Per Organism, All Sites")
gt::gtsave(gt_culture_to_gram_model, filename = paste0(figure_path, "culture_matches_gram_multivariate_model_table.html"))
```

#### Organism Co-occurence Matrix

```{r}

culture_data_cooccurrence_input <- 
  culture_data_with_growth_bin |> 
    arrange(SubjectID, MALDI_ID, desc(LRT_REF_RPT_BIN)) |>
    ungroup() |> 
    slice_head(n = 1, by = c(SubjectID, MALDI_ID)) |>
    filter(NUM_UNIQUE_ORGANISMS > 1) |> 
    select(SpecimenID, MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED)

org_counts <- culture_data_cooccurrence_input |> count(MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED, sort = T)
expected_props <- org_counts |> mutate(prop = n / length(unique(culture_data_cooccurrence_input$SpecimenID)))

organism_cooccurrence <- crossprod(table(culture_data_cooccurrence_input[1:2]))
organism_cooccurrence_normalized <- organism_cooccurrence

for(i in 1:nrow(organism_cooccurrence)){
  for(j in 1:ncol(organism_cooccurrence)){
    organism_cooccurrence_normalized[i,j] <- organism_cooccurrence[i,j]/organism_cooccurrence[j,j]
  }
}

tmp <- organism_cooccurrence_normalized |> as_tibble()
tmp$organism_1 <- names(tmp)

gg_cooccur_input <- 
  tmp |> 
    pivot_longer(-matches("organism_1"), names_to = "organism_2", values_to = "cooccurence") |> 
    mutate(organism_1 = fct_rev(factor(organism_1, levels = org_counts$MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED)),
           organism_2 = factor(organism_2, levels = org_counts$MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED))

ggplot(gg_cooccur_input |> slice_head(), aes(organism_2, organism_1, fill = cooccurence)) + 
  geom_tile() + 
  scico::scale_fill_scico(direction = -1) + 
  theme(axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), axis.text = element_text(size = 6))
```

#### Cooccurrence Stats

```{r}

cooccur_template <- expand_grid(organism_1 = org_counts$MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED, organism_2 = org_counts$MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED)

cooccur_labels <- 
  map2(cooccur_template$organism_1, cooccur_template$organism_2, 
     ~culture_data_cooccurrence_input |> 
        group_by(SpecimenID) |> 
        transmute(cooccur = 
                    case_when(
                      !any(MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED == .x) & !any(MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED == .y) ~ "Neither",
                      any(MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED == .x) & !any(MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED == .y) ~ "Only 1",
                      !any(MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED == .x) & any(MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED == .y) ~ "Only 2",
                      any(MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED == .x) & any(MALDI_ID_COLLAPSED == .y) ~ "Both"), 
                  organism_1 = .x,
                  organism_2 = .y)) |> 
    bind_rows()

cooccur_test_input <- 
  cooccur_labels |> 
    filter(organism_1 != organism_2) |> 
    distinct() |> 
    group_by(organism_1, organism_2) |> 
    count(cooccur) |> 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = matches("organism"), names_from = "cooccur", values_from = n) |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    mutate(across(!matches("organ"), ~as.integer(ifelse(is.na(.), 0, .))))

get_fisher <- function(df){
  mat <- matrix(as.numeric(df[c(4, 5, 6, 3)]), nrow=2)
  f <- fisher.test(as.table(mat), alt="two.sided")
  return(tibble_row("org_1" = df[1], "org_2" = df[2], "p" = f$p.value, "OR" = f$estimate, "CI_low" = f$conf.int[1], "CI_high" = f$conf.int[2]))
}

fishers <- apply(cooccur_test_input, 1, get_fisher)
  
fishers <- fishers |> bind_rows() |> arrange(p) %>% slice(seq(1, nrow(.), by = 2)) |> mutate(CI_high = ifelse(!is.finite(CI_high), 10000, CI_high), organism_tag = fct_rev(fct_reorder(factor(paste0(org_1, " and ", org_2)), p)))

gg_cooccur_ci <- 
  ggplot(fishers |> filter(p < 0.25), aes(x = CI_low, xend = CI_high, y = organism_tag, yend = organism_tag)) + 
    geom_segment() +
    geom_point() +
    geom_point(aes(x = CI_high, y = organism_tag)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "95% CI of Odds Ratio") + 
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 2)) + 
    theme(axis.title.y.left = element_blank(), axis.text.y.left = element_text(size = 6))
ggsave(paste0(figure_path, "cooccurance_significant_odds_ratios_forest.pdf"), gg_cooccur_ci, width = 8, height = 5)

gg_cooccur_ci
```

## Subject-Wise Tables

```{r}

gram_results_by_subject <- 
  gram_stain_data |>
    group_by(SubjectID) |> 
    summarise(
      max_epi = max(LRT_REF_SQ_EPI_AMT, na.rm = T),
      max_poly = max(LRT_REF_PLS_AMT, na.rm = T),
      max_rbc = max(LRT_REF_RBC_AMT, na.rm = T),
      gram_NONE = !any(!is.na(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH), na.rm = T),
      gram_GPC = any(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH == "Gram-positive cocci", na.rm = T),
      gram_GNB = any(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH == "Gram-negative bacilli", na.rm = T),
      gram_MIXED = any(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH == "Mixed microorganism", na.rm = T),
      gram_GPB = any(LRT_REF_GS_MORPH == "Gram-positive bacilli", na.rm = T)) |> 
    ungroup() |> 
    left_join(distinct(gram_stain_data |> distinct(SubjectID, LRT_REF_GS_SPECTYPE) |> drop_na()))

gt_gram_by_subject <- 
  tbl_summary(gram_results_by_subject |> select(-SubjectID), by = LRT_REF_GS_SPECTYPE, label = c("gram_GPC" ~ "Gram-Positive Cocci", "gram_GNB" ~ "Gram-Negative Bacilli", "gram_MIXED" ~ "Mixed Microorganism", "gram_GPB" ~ "Gram-Positive Bacilli", "max_poly" ~ "Maximum Neutrophils", "max_epi" ~ "Maximum Squamous Epithelial Cells", "max_rbc" ~ "Maximum Red Blood Cells"), statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n}"), missing = "ifany", missing_text = "None") |>
    italicize_levels() |>
    bold_labels() |> 
      add_p() |>  
      bold_p() |> 
      add_ci(pattern = "{stat}<br>{ci}", statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "[{conf.low}% - {conf.high}%]")) |> 
      modify_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**<br>*N = {n}*") |>
      modify_footnote(everything() ~ NA, abbreviation = T) |> 
      modify_footnote(update = everything() ~ NA) |>
      modify_footnote(update = everything() ~ "N, [95% CI]") |>
        as_gt() |> 
        theme_pattern() |>
        tab_header(title = "Gram Stain Results", subtitle = "Per Subject, By Procedure Type")

gt::gtsave(gt_gram_by_subject, filename = paste0(figure_path, "gram_stain_results_by_subject_table.html"))
gt::gtsave(gt_gram_by_subject, filename = paste0(figure_path, "gram_stain_results_by_subject_table.docx"))


culture_results_by_subject <- 
  culture_data_input |> 
    left_join(gram_results_by_subject |> select(SubjectID, LRT_REF_GS_SPECTYPE)) |> 
    group_by(SubjectID) |> 
    summarise(
      LRT_REF_GS_SPECTYPE,
      num_org = max(NUM_UNIQUE_ORGANISMS),
      max_normal_flora = max(LRT_REF_NF_AMT, na.rm = T),
      any_contam = any(REF_LRT_CONTAM_YN == "Yes", na.rm = T),
      any_growth = any(LRT_REF_GRWTH_YN == "Yes", na.rm = T),
      pseudomonas = any(MALDI_ID_GROUPED == "Pseudomonas aeruginosa", na.rm = T),
      staph = any(MALDI_ID_GROUPED == "Staphylococcus aureus", na.rm = T),
      yeast = any(MALDI_ID_GROUPED == "Yeast", na.rm = T),
      klebsiella = any(MALDI_ID_GROUPED == "Klebsiella pneumoniae", na.rm = T),
      steno = any(MALDI_ID_GROUPED == "Stenotrophomonas maltophilia", na.rm = T),
      serratia = any(MALDI_ID_GROUPED == "Serratia marcescens", na.rm = T),
      ecoli = any(MALDI_ID_GROUPED == "Escherichia coli", na.rm = T),
      acinetobacter = any(MALDI_ID_GROUPED == "Acinetobacter baumannii-calcoaceticus complex", na.rm = T),
      hflu = any(MALDI_ID_GROUPED == "Haemophilus influenzae", na.rm = T),
      culture_GPC = any(`Gram stain` == "Gram-positive cocci", na.rm = T),
      culture_GNB = any(`Gram stain` == "Gram-negative bacilli", na.rm = T),
      culture_MIXED = any(grepl("positive", `Gram stain`), na.rm = T) & any(grepl("negative", `Gram stain`), na.rm = T),
      culture_YEAST = any(`Gram stain` == "Yeast", na.rm = T),
      culture_GPB = any(`Gram stain` == "Gram-positive bacilli", na.rm = T)) |> 
    distinct() |> 
    ungroup()

gt_culture_by_subject <- 
  tbl_summary(culture_results_by_subject |> select(-SubjectID), by = LRT_REF_GS_SPECTYPE, label = c("num_org" ~ "Number of Unique Organisms", "max_normal_flora" ~ "Abundance of Normal Flora", "any_contam" ~ "Contaminated?", "any_growth" ~ "Any Growth?", "culture_GPC" ~ "Gram-Positive Cocci", "culture_GNB" ~ "Gram-Negative Bacilli", "culture_MIXED" ~ "Mixed Microorganism", "culture_GPB" ~ "Gram-Positive Bacilli", "culture_YEAST" ~ "Yeast"), statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n}, ({p}%)")) |>
    italicize_levels() |>
    bold_labels() |> 
      add_p(test = everything() ~ "fisher.test", test.args = all_tests("fisher.test") ~ list(simulate.p.value = TRUE)) |>  
      bold_p() |> 
      add_ci(pattern = "{stat}<br>{ci}", statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "[{conf.low}% - {conf.high}%]", all_continuous() ~ "[{conf.low} - {conf.high}]")) |> 
      modify_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**<br>*N = {n}*") |>
      modify_footnote(everything() ~ NA, abbreviation = T) |> 
      modify_footnote(update = everything() ~ NA) |>
      modify_footnote(update = everything() ~ "N or Mean, (Percentage). [95% Confidence Interval]") |>
        as_gt() |> 
        theme_pattern() |>
        tab_header(title = "Culture Results", subtitle = "Per Subject, By Procedure Type")

gt::gtsave(gt_culture_by_subject, filename = paste0(figure_path, "culture_results_by_subject_table.html"))
gt::gtsave(gt_culture_by_subject, filename = paste0(figure_path, "culture_results_by_subject_table.docx"))

gt_culture_by_subject
```

# Topic 2: Antibiotic Timings

```{r}

pbc_one <- readxl::read_xlsx(paste0(data_path, "PBC_Enrollment.xlsx"), na = c("NA", "<NA>", "N/A", "n/a"))
pbc_two <- readxl::read_xlsx(paste0(data_path, "PBC_Enrollment_Collection_Site.xlsx"), na = c("NA", "<NA>", "N/A", "n/a")) |> mutate(PBC_TTP = as.character(PBC_TTP), PBC_BloodVol = as.character(PBC_BloodVol))

### TODO Look into site4 data 

### TODO Other antibiotics: Add ampicillin and micafungin to separate rows, drop nystatin, rifAXIMin

antibiotics <- 
  bind_rows(pbc_one, pbc_two) |> 
    rowwise() |>
      mutate(
        TypeID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[1],
        SiteID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[2],
        SpecimenID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[3],
        ReplicateID = str_split(SubjectID, "-", simplify = T)[4],
      ) |> ungroup() |> 
      group_by(SubjectID) |> 
      fill(everything(), .direction = "downup") |> 
      ungroup() |> 
      distinct() |> 
    mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ factor(.x))) |> 
    mutate(num_antibiotics = n(), .by = SubjectID)

antibiotics |> 
  select(SiteID, PBC_PtAge, SEX, PBC_PtLocation, PBC_PtAbx, ORG_ID_PBC, num_antibiotics) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  tbl_summary(sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) |> 
    italicize_levels() |>
    bold_labels() |> 
    as_gt() |> 
    theme_pattern() |>
    tab_header(title = "Antibiotic Data Summary", subtitle = "By Unique Bug-Drug Combos")
```

## Definitions

```{r}

broad_spectrum <- 
  c("Vancomycin", 
    "Cefepime", 
    "Piperacillin-Tazobactam", 
    "Meropenem", 
    "Linezolid",
    "Azithromycin",
    "Daptomycin",
    "Ciprofloxacin",
    "Levofloxacin",
    "Tobramycin",
    "Doxycycline",
    "Gentamicin",
    "Minocycline",
    "Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole",
    "Ceftaroline", 
    "Aztreonam", 
    "Ertapenem", 
    "Imipenem-relebactam", 
    "Meropenem-vaborbactam")

empirics <- 
  c("Vancomycin", 
    "Meropenem", 
    "Meropenem-vaborbactam",
    "Imipenem-relebactam",
    "Ertapenem", 
    "Cefepime", 
    "Piperacillin-Tazobactam",
    "Ciprofloxacin",
    "Levofloxacin")

destinations <- 
  c("Ceftriaxone", 
    "Oxacillin")

## Rules: Vanc if MRSA, Dapto if VRE | MRSA, Linezolid if VRE | MRSA,
```

```{r}
antibiotics_preprocedure <- antibiotics |> filter(PBC_StartAbx < PBC_SpecimenCollection)

antibiotics_preprocedure |>
  select(SiteID, PBC_PtAge, SEX, PBC_PtLocation, PBC_PtAbx, ORG_ID_PBC, num_antibiotics) |> 
    distinct() |> 
    tbl_summary(sort = list(everything() ~ "frequency")) |> 
      italicize_levels() |>
      bold_labels() |> 
      as_gt() |> 
      theme_pattern() |>
      tab_header(title = "Antibiotics Pre-Procedure Data Summary", subtitle = "By Unique Bug-Drug Combos")
```

## Relative Start Times

```{r}

# Add relative collection time
antibiotics <- 
  antibiotics |> 
    mutate(time_to_collection = difftime(PBC_StartAbx, PBC_SpecimenCollection, units = c("days")), 
           isBroad = PBC_PtAbxResult %in% broad_spectrum,
           isEmpiric = PBC_PtAbxResult %in% empirics)

# Remove results outside of one-week window on either side.
antibiotics_trimmed <- antibiotics |> filter(between(as.numeric(time_to_collection), -7, 7))

# Plot all results
gg_abx_to_collection <- 
  ggplot(antibiotics, aes(x = time_to_collection)) + 
    stat_dotsinterval(side = "bottom", layout = "hex", na.rm = T) + 
    stat_halfeye(side = "top", na.rm = T) + 
    ylab("Frequency") + 
    theme(legend.position = "none")
gg_abx_to_collection

# Plot all results within a week of collection
gg_abx_to_collection_trim <- 
  ggplot(antibiotics_trimmed, aes(x = time_to_collection)) + 
    stat_dotsinterval(side = "bottom", layout = "hex", na.rm = T) + 
    stat_halfeye(side = "top", na.rm = T) + 
    ylab("Frequency") + 
    theme(legend.position = "none")
gg_abx_to_collection_trim

# Plot all results by floor
### TODO Ask for clarification on how locations are assigned
gg_abx_to_collection_by_floor <- 
  ggplot(antibiotics_trimmed, aes(x = time_to_collection, fill = PBC_PtLocation)) + 
    geom_density(alpha = 0.5) + 
    ylab("Frequency") + 
    theme(legend.position = "right")
gg_abx_to_collection_by_floor

# Plot all results by antibiotic
gg_abx_to_collection_by_drug <- 
  ggplot(antibiotics_trimmed, aes(x = time_to_collection, fill = PBC_PtAbxResult)) + 
    geom_density(position = "fill", adjust = 10, stat = "count") + 
    scico::scale_fill_scico_d(palette = "batlow") + 
    ylab("Frequency") + 
    theme(legend.position = "right")
gg_abx_to_collection_by_drug

# Plot all results by broad vs. narrow
gg_abx_to_collection_by_spectrum <- 
  ggplot(antibiotics_trimmed, aes(x = time_to_collection, fill = isBroad)) + 
    geom_density(position = "fill") + 
    scico::scale_fill_scico_d(palette = "batlow") + 
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-3, 3)) +
    ylab("Frequency") + 
    theme(legend.position = "right")
gg_abx_to_collection_by_spectrum

# Plot all results by empiric
gg_abx_to_collection_by_empiric <- 
  ggplot(antibiotics_trimmed, aes(x = time_to_collection, fill = isEmpiric)) + 
    geom_density(position = "fill", adjust = 10) + 
    scico::scale_fill_scico_d(palette = "batlow") + 
    scale_x_continuous() +
    ylab("Frequency") + 
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-2, 2)) + 
    theme(legend.position = "right")
gg_abx_to_collection_by_empiric
```
